coverage.checklistItem: Record the accessibility target and choose representative pages, workflows, states, browsers, and assistive technologies.
coverage.note: The runner records one target URL but cannot decide whether the review sample is representative.

coverage.checklistItem: Record anything that could not be tested.
coverage.note: The package records automated collector errors and skipped evidence; the reviewer must add broader limitations.

coverage.checklistItem: Involve a qualified accessibility reviewer when the risk or required conformance claim calls for one.
coverage.note: Reviewer qualifications and project risk require human judgment.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm every page has a useful title and language.
coverage.note: The runner detects missing values; a reviewer must judge whether the title and language are useful and correct.

coverage.checklistItem: Check headings, landmarks, reading order, and the name and role of controls.
coverage.note: Counts and axe rules provide evidence, but meaningful structure and reading order require review.

coverage.checklistItem: Write meaningful alternative text and mark decorative images appropriately.
coverage.note: Automation detects some missing or invalid alternatives but cannot judge meaning in context.

coverage.checklistItem: Provide captions, transcripts, or audio description for media when required.
coverage.note: Automation may detect some missing tracks but cannot assess completeness or accuracy.

coverage.checklistItem: Complete important tasks using only the keyboard.
coverage.note: The generic single-page runner does not execute project-specific journeys.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm focus is visible, sensible, and not hidden by other content.
coverage.note: Focus behavior must be reviewed through representative keyboard interaction.

coverage.checklistItem: Test the site's menus, dialogs, and other custom controls.
coverage.note: Custom-control behavior requires interaction in each relevant state.

coverage.checklistItem: Provide alternatives for dragging, complex gestures, and motion controls.
coverage.note: The runner cannot determine whether equivalent interactions exist across workflows.

coverage.checklistItem: Check text, control, and focus-indicator contrast.
coverage.note: axe detects many rendered contrast failures, but states and custom focus indicators still require review.

coverage.checklistItem: Test browser zoom to 200 percent and text spacing overrides.
coverage.note: The baseline profile does not apply and assess zoom or text-spacing overrides.

coverage.checklistItem: Confirm content reflows without losing information or functionality at the WCAG zoom-equivalent width of 320 CSS pixels, which represents a 1280 CSS-pixel desktop viewport at 400 percent zoom; test current mobile viewports separately when they are in scope.
coverage.note: The 320 CSS-pixel reflow check represents desktop zoom, not a mobile-device simulation. A reviewer must inspect current mobile responsive states and interactions separately when they are in scope.

coverage.checklistItem: Respect reduced-motion preferences and make controls reasonably easy to target.
coverage.note: The baseline profile does not judge motion alternatives or target usability.

coverage.checklistItem: Give fields clear labels and connect understandable errors to the affected fields.
coverage.note: Automation detects some label and relationship failures; error quality and workflow require interaction.

coverage.checklistItem: Preserve valid input and announce important status changes when needed.
coverage.note: State preservation and announcements require workflow testing.

coverage.checklistItem: Let users review or correct submissions that create legal or financial commitments.
coverage.note: The relevant commitments and correction workflow require product and legal context.

coverage.checklistItem: Do not block paste, password managers, or accessible authentication methods.
coverage.note: Authentication behavior requires authorized interaction and appropriate test accounts.

coverage.checklistItem: Run an automated scan, review the results, and test important workflows with a screen reader.
coverage.note: The runner completes automated scans but does not claim screen-reader testing.

coverage.checklistItem: Retest fixes and check shared components for the same problem.
coverage.note: Retesting depends on the changed release and representative component usage.

coverage.checklistItem: Record affected users, evidence, severity, and any testing limitations.
coverage.note: The evidence package records observations and limitations; the reviewer determines affected users and severity.
